candidate.description: Audit and deploy Sherwood v2 on Robinhood Chain (4663) for $IMD, with no new token. Sherwood v2 (src/SherwoodV2.sol) is a Uniswap v4 hook running a leaderboard game in rolling 20-hour rounds on one native-ETH/$IMD pool: every buy scores points and pays 5% of its ETH into the round's pot.
